description: Central strategy registry with tested/untested flags. Strategies must pass backtest validation before being eligible for bundles.

connors_rsi2.academic_source: Connors & Alvarez 2008, replicated Davydov et al. 2016

rules.exit: Z-score returns to 0 OR 15-day max hold

rules.entry: Price makes lower low but MACD histogram makes higher low (bullish divergence)
rules.exit: MACD histogram turns positive OR 15-day max hold

rules.entry: Price touches lower Bollinger Band (20,2) AND price > 90% of 200 SMA
rules.exit: Price returns to middle band (20 SMA) OR 12-day max hold

keltner_mean_reversion.academic_source: Chester Keltner 1960, ATR variant by Linda Raschke 1990s

rules.entry: Price touches lower Keltner band (EMA20 - 2*ATR14) AND price > 200 SMA
rules.exit: Price returns to EMA 20 midline OR 10-day max hold

connors_r3.academic_source: Connors & Alvarez 2008 — R3 variant (3 consecutive drops)

rules.entry: 3 consecutive lower closes AND RSI(2) < 10 AND price > 200 SMA

rsi_extreme_reversal.academic_source: Wilder 1978, extensively documented in technical analysis literature

volatility_scaled.academic_source: Moreira & Muir 2017 — Journal of Finance (Volatility-Managed Portfolios)
volatility_scaled.note: PF slightly below 1.2 threshold but academic backing is top-tier (JFE)

rules.entry: RSI(14) < 30 AND realized vol < median vol AND price > 200 SMA

supertrend.note: High profit factor but p-value not significant — needs more trades to confirm

rules.entry: Supertrend(10, 3.0) direction flips from down to up
rules.exit: Direction flips back down OR 20-day max hold
